location_exception_reason: Mobile Cabins are industrial/commercial structures sold nationwide; location of manufacture or seller is not a buyer decision factor. GI tagging or regional origin does not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Mobile Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged.
